announcements.title: LAX People Mover Testing
announcements.message: The LAX Automated People Mover is currently in testing phase. Expected to open June 2026.

announcements.title: D Line Section 2 Under Construction
announcements.message: Wilshire/La Brea, Wilshire/Fairfax, and Wilshire/La Cienega stations are under construction, expected to open in 2025.

announcements.title: Sepulveda Transit Corridor LPA Approved
announcements.message: The Sepulveda Transit Corridor Locally Preferred Alternative (Modified Alt 5) was approved in January 2026. The automated heavy rail line will connect the San Fernando Valley to LAX via Westwood.

announcements.title: C Line Extension to Torrance LPA Approved
announcements.message: The C Line Extension to Torrance (Alternative 3 - elevated on Hawthorne Blvd) was approved in January 2026. Expected opening: 2036.
